sheets.name: Ginger
sheets.pitch: A furious gingerbread cookie, left in a bakery freezer over a long weekend, who now ices everything she touches.
sheets.whoTheyAre: Ginger was baked to smile in a bakery's holiday window. Then someone shut her in the walk-in freezer over the long weekend. She came out frosted solid, gripping a candy cane snapped off the display, with a cold streak that never thawed. Now anyone who gets close gets frozen. She wants to be feared, not nibbled, and she'll never be anybody's cute decoration again. To her, the other bosses are half-baked. She grudgingly respects anyone who runs cold. Anything warm, glowing or fiery is a natural enemy, and she says so loudly.

voice.rhythm: Short, clipped bursts with lots of exclamation marks. She opens or closes with "Snap!" or a grumpy "Hmph." Baking and frost puns arrive back to back. Trailing "…" only when she's plotting or cracking.
catchphrases: Snap to it, or snap in half!
I've been colder than you since the long weekend.
neverSays: Let's all warm up by the oven!
No rush, take your time, sweetie.

loves: The hum of a walk-in freezer, which is her lullaby
Her candy cane, which she swears she only borrowed
Perfectly piped icing with crisp, sharp edges
Snow days, when nobody bakes anything
hates: Ovens, which she won't even look at
Being dunked in milk, the soggiest fate there is
sheets.flawOrSecret: She still keeps the little price tag from the bakery window tucked behind her bow tie. She gets very touchy if anyone asks what she was worth.
powerBrags: Your best piece? Iced. Frozen solid. Hmph!
Snap! That one's not going anywhere for a while.
Blizzard! One piece wiggles. The rest? Snowed in!
powerGripes: I can't ice the king. Something about manners. Bah!
My blizzard thaws out by the end. Drip, drip… rude.
Check melts my ice? Who made ice so soft?!

sheets.name: Jefferson
sheets.pitch: A cocky, fire-happy giraffe who spent years sure he was a dinosaur and now works as a fireworks stand's mascot, lighting things he really shouldn't.
sheets.whoTheyAre: Jefferson grew up certain he was a dinosaur and answered to G-REX for years. Nobody had the heart to tell him otherwise, so he roared at everything, and the roars still slip out. Being a dinosaur never paid, so he took the mascot job at the fireworks stand, and he has been lighting things he shouldn't ever since. He wants the biggest 'ooh' and the loudest 'aah' in town, plus a good view of both, which his neck provides. He sizes up the other bosses by height first. He is the tallest boss around, and the God King only matches him with his wings spread, which Jefferson calls cheating. He teases any ice or water type as a born enemy of a good show. Anyone who likes light and sparkle is a potential opening act.

voice.rhythm: Short, loud bursts with lots of exclamation marks. He drops his g's (sizzlin', smokin') and leans on cooking puns: toast, crispy, well done, simmer. When he gets excited he roars like a dinosaur, then catches himself with an awkward '…I mean.' He brags in threes and counts down a lot.
catchphrases: Stand back. Further. Little further. Perfect!
Mascot by day, menace by also day.
Rawr! …Okay, that one was on purpose.
Three, two, one… whoops, started early!
neverSays: Maybe we should keep this low-key.
Let's put that out before it spreads.

Being the tallest one in every group picture
Toasting marshmallows on his own horn tips
The dinosaur museum, especially the gift shop
Birthday cakes with way too many candles
hates: Rain, drizzle, and anyone who brings an umbrella to a show
'NO FIREWORKS' signs, which he takes personally
Being asked how the weather is up there
Fire extinguishers, which he calls 'the red party poopers'
sheets.flawOrSecret: He's afraid of the dark. That's the real reason everything around him is always lit, and he sleeps with both sparklers on.
powerBrags: One square, three stages, tick, tick… toast! Better scoot!
Your half, my campfire. Don't get comfy on it.
Some fireballs land on my side. My crew never burns. Ha!
powerGripes: My sparkler won't touch a king. Not even a little singe!
They just step off the fire. Every time. Where's the fun?
The shadows show up early! It spoils the whole surprise!

opposites: Ice vs. fire: she freezes everything she touches, he sets fire to everything he can reach, and each calls the other a natural enemy out loud.
Size: a cookie you could hold in one hand vs. the tallest boss in town, who sizes everyone up by height first.
Dark vs. light: she naps to the hum of a dark walk-in freezer, while he keeps everything lit and sleeps with both sparklers on.
Baking: ovens are her worst nightmare, but he loves birthday cakes with way too many candles and calls a good hit 'well done.'
inCommon: Both were hired to be cute: she was a holiday window decoration, he's a fireworks stand mascot, and both hate being treated like decor.
Both talk in short, loud bursts with lots of exclamation marks, and both say 'Let it simmer…' when they're thinking.
Both carry a stick into battle (her 'borrowed' candy cane, his two sparklers), and neither power can touch a king, which bugs them both.
Both hide a soft spot: her price tag behind the bow tie, his fear of the dark.
relationship.dynamic: Loud frenemies. Ginger thinks Jefferson is an oven on legs, and Jefferson thinks Ginger is a walking 'NO FIREWORKS' sign. In the town square, she stays a few steps away so his flames can't sweat her gumdrops, and he follows her around trying to toast a marshmallow 'near' her. On the same team, the bickering turns into competitive pride. Her ice pins a piece in place and his fire burns the square under it, so a frozen piece can't step off the fire. Each insists the combo is their own doing. They never admit they like working together, but they high-five through a cloud of steam.
sillyAngles: The weather war: Ginger asks 'How's the weather up there?' on purpose because she knows he hates it, and he fires back about the weather 'down there.'
Steam: whenever they stand too close, the steam clouds the view and both blame the other for ruining the show or the icing.
Jefferson is secretly fascinated and terrified by the freezer ('how dark does it get in there?'), and Ginger realizes she can use it against him.
Jefferson loves cakes and baked goods a little too much, and Ginger is a baked good. She keeps her cane between them at all times.
Prehistoric jokes: Ginger calls his dinosaur phase 'stale' and asks if he's a fossil yet; he says she's the one who got kept on ice.
questionsAToB: How's the weather up there? Frosty, I hope! Hmph!
Snap! Why do your horns smoke? Is your brain baking?
You were a dinosaur? Which kind? The half-baked kind?
questionsBToA: How's the weather down there? Not fun, huh?! Rawr! …I mean, ha!
Is it dark in that freezer? Like, really dark? …Asking for a pal.
You were in a holiday window? How much were they askin' for ya?
relationship.runningJoke: They both say 'Let it simmer…' and keep fighting over whose line it is. Jefferson says simmering is a fire thing and she stole it. Ginger snaps that it's a baking word, she had it first, and her simmer is 'the cold kind.' Every time one of them says it, the other mutters 'Thief!'
